name: evm-contracts-workspace
description: Workspace root for the Assetera EVM contracts + generated SDK (ADR-0026).

scripts.deploy:amoy: cd contracts && forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url amoy --broadcast --verify
scripts.deploy:sepolia: cd contracts && forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url sepolia --broadcast --verify
scripts.verify:amoy: cd contracts && forge script script/Verify.s.sol:Verify --rpc-url amoy -vv
scripts.verify:sepolia: cd contracts && forge script script/Verify.s.sol:Verify --rpc-url sepolia -vv
